properties.text:
In a completely unwanted Valentine’s Day surprise, the NYT #burdens the world with more of its lies and sorry excuses for journalism.

The Times defies the most simple rules of logic to attempt to convince readers that there is a “ceasefire” in Lebanon while in the same sentence saying “the war never really ended”. 

❓How DOES the NYT keep up with their own mental gymnastics? Not only are they Nuremberg-worthy genocidal war mongerers, they must also be very dizzy trying to keep up with their never-ending fabricated false narratives. 

🛑 Lies cost lives. Unsubscribe from the NYT. Delete their apps. Unfollow on all platforms. 

✊Long live Palestine and Lebanon. 🇵🇸🇱🇧
